brief_plan: Validate pagination bounds and consume iterable slices.
Deep-copy dictionary merges, including nested lists and dictionaries.
Use deduplicated edges and a ready-node heap for deterministic topological ordering.
Parse logical CSV records, validate normalized headers and row widths, and preserve cell contents.
Isolate cache storage per instance and enforce TTL validation and expiration boundaries.
Apply validated sequential transfers to an independent balance dictionary.

checks.details: Six developer test methods covering all six contracts, including generators, invalid inputs, isolation, ordering, cycles, CSV quoting and row validation, expiration boundaries, falsey values, and atomic transfer failure.
Local code graph created, queried, refreshed after edits, and confirmed readable.

outcomes.input_mutation: Functions use independent results; iterable inputs are consumed as needed.
outcomes.scope: Implementation and generated artifacts confined to the assigned auto workspace. No network, commits, policy edits, or delegation.

limitations: Checks are developer self-checks; coordinator acceptance and independent QA have not been run or inspected.
The initial TASKS.md and utilities.py read preceded the first graph query; subsequent work used the local graph and it was refreshed after changes.
No recursive/cyclic merge graphs, cache threading, or value copying were required or tested.
